About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Location: London (hybrid)

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As a Senior Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a core driver of technical execution and innovation within our data organization. You take complex business challenges and translate them into robust, scalable data products and machine learning models. You will be trusted to operate with high autonomy, owning your projects from the initial exploratory analysis through to production deployment.

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize our operations, refine our marketing efforts, and enhance the customer experience. You will not only build powerful models but also help uphold the engineering rigor and standards of our data team.

You Will:

  • Build from Scratch: Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write complex SQL, engineer your own features, and deploy baseline models (heuristics or simple ML) quickly to prove value before iterating toward complex solutions.

  • End-to-End Execution: Own the complete model lifecycle, from data extraction and feature engineering to deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to define technical requirements and translate model outputs into clear, actionable business insights.

  • Uphold Technical Standards: Write clean, modular, and production-ready code. Actively participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical best practices.

  • Drive Project Delivery: Navigate technical ambiguity within your domain, breaking down complex project requirements into manageable, executable milestones.

  • Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and support to junior data scientists and analysts, helping them troubleshoot roadblocks and adopt best practices.

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of applied experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a track record of delivering production-ready models that drive measurable business value.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Python and SQL. Deep familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and standard ML frameworks (such as PyTorch, XGBoost, or LightGBM).

  • Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to build for production. Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS or GCP) and familiarity with CI/CD workflows, version control (Git), and ML Ops principles.

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Strong ability to connect technical metrics to business outcomes. You know how to choose the right algorithm for the right problem rather than just the most complex one.

  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Education: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines.

  • Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

    • Applied Forecasting: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or handling non-stationary data for demand or revenue planning.

    • Optimization: Building engines for marketing spend, inventory management, or resource allocation.

    • Causal Inference: Designing robust experiments (e.g., quasi-experiments, difference-in-differences) to measure true business impact beyond standard A/B testing.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue.

The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next.

What will you be doing?

  • Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available.

  • Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance.

  • Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs.

  • Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations.

  • Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems.

  • Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor.

  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them.

  • Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us

  • Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do.

  • A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days.

  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company.

  • Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute.

You may not like it here

  • Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. Time is of the essence.

  • You'll be expected to still do the job yourself when it's busy — reviewing logs, digging into an API issue, especially on escalations or incidents — not just delegate and report up.

  • Consistency is graded harder here than almost anywhere else.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

STARK's maritime division is at the forefront of autonomous surface and subsea innovation. We are building the next generation of modular, sensor-integrated maritime platforms designed to dominate in complex, contested environments. You will work closely with cross-functional teams of systems engineers, naval architects, and software developers to bridge the gap between cutting-edge engineering and operational deployment. Our team values rapid iteration, technical rigour, and a bias for action in everything we build.


Your mission

As Product Manager for Maritime, you own the development of STARK’s software-defined maritime capabilities and complex sensor suites. You will direct the integration of these systems by driving high-tempo collaboration with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams. Your mission is to translate tactical operational requirements into dominant, mass-scalable platforms that ensure NATO maritime superiority.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end development of software-defined maritime capabilities and mission-critical sensor suites.

  • Direct the integration of advanced sensors and autonomous software by leading collaboration across System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Drive product testing strategies—including Software-in-the-Loop (SITL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL), and full hardware/software integrations—in lockstep with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Lead strategic market analysis to identify and capture platform opportunities for NATO allied forces.

  • Manage the complete product lifecycle from prototype to deployment and customer acceptance.

  • Enforce rigorous safety and compliance standards across the maritime product portfolio.

  • Communicate product vision and strategic milestones to internal stakeholders and external defence partners.


Qualifications

  • Technical degree (e.g. Maritime/Systems Engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in product management delivering complex maritime/defence systems.

  • Understanding of maritime operations and sensor integration.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and navigate regulatory requirements.

  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a UK security clearance.


Nice to have

  • Experience with naval projects or autonomous/robotic platforms.

  • Background in defence-tech or rapid-growth aerospace.

  • Experience working in a V-model while maintaining agile development pace.


If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected in the description above, please send us your CV in English. We look forward to meeting you!

At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

 
 

What you'll do

Build integrations that unlock Luna’s next capabilities

  • Design and implement read/write integrations into third-party practice management systems

  • Design infrastructure that scales to hundreds of thousands of individual practice servers

  • Engineer reliability into the system: data consistency, idempotency, retries, error handling, observability

  • Triage integration failures in production, communicate impact clearly, and harden the system so the same class of failure doesn’t repeat

Make integration a scalable capability

  • Define technical standards and architecture for integrations

  • Establish pragmatic processes for development, maintenance, and incident handling

 

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, TypeScript and/or Rust

  • Proven experience building and running software in production

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, distributed systems, and failure modes

  • Comfort operating in messy environments (inconsistent behavior, missing docs, etc.)

  • Clear communication under pressure (during incidents, vendor issues, competing priorities)

  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have

  • Prior work on healthcare software or practice management systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, or data standards (e.g. FHIR)

  • Fluent German (spoken and written)

  • Experience in startups or scale-ups

 

Location & compensation

  • Location: Remote

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and participation in our VSOP program

  • Team bonding: Regular get-togethers, happy hours and offsites

  • Health and productivity: Urban Sports Club subscription

 

If you want to shape the next generation of healthcare software with us, apply now.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

What you will be doing

The Head of Brand Marketing ensures that Faculty looks, sounds and shows up like the category leader it is: through a distinctive brand, a body of storytelling with a genuine point of view, a library of sharp assets that bring to life the exceptional work of our teams, and a marketing plan that is tightly aligned to Faculty’s business plan and strategic intent. It is delivered with a standard of craft that means nothing about Faculty ever feels accidental.

Strategic Responsibilities

This role has two core mandates:

1. Brand Strategy & Differentiation

You will be the primary custodian of the Faculty brand. Differentiating and elevating Faculty is a core strategic priority: you will position the company as the clear leader in applied AI, building reputation through bold, opinionated storytelling rather than the vague futurism that dominates so much of AI marketing.

2. Marketing Strategy & Delivery

You will co-create Faculty’s marketing strategy with the Director of Marketing and Communications, and develop and own the marketing plan that brings it to life, in line with Faculty's overall business plan and strategic intent.

You will hold the bar for excellence in marketing delivery: every asset matches the premium feel of our brand, every campaign is executed with purpose and precision, every narrative is crisp and intentional.

You will oversee events, digital, creative and content, making sure everything we produce is sharp, crisp, high quality and unmistakably Faculty.

Key Deliverables:

Brand & Narrative

  • Primary custodian of the Faculty brand

  • Foundational assets: corporate and commercial narratives, brand guidelines, case studies, canonical assets, ensuring central assets are culturally sensitive and travel well

  • Faculty differentiation: build Faculty’s reputation as a leader in applied AI through powerful storytelling about our work and opinionated perspectives on applied AI

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the marketing plan, ensuring it is tightly aligned to the business plan and able to flex as priorities shift.

  • Sit as a core member of the Marketing Leadership Team, shaping decisions that affect the wider function and bringing a brand and marketing lens to the leadership table.

  • Use data and audience insight to prioritise investment, favouring durable brand equity and growth over vanity metrics.

Marketing Delivery

  • Ensure every asset matches the premium feel of the Faculty brand and speaks directly to the audiences it's built for

  • Execute with purpose and precision: every campaign, launch and piece of content should have a clear reason to exist and a clear standard it's held to.

  • Set and protect a language standard that is parsimonious and human: no jargon, no filler, no vague futurism, just clear, confident writing that respects the reader.

Digital, Creative & Content Oversight

  • Oversee digital, creative, events, and content, ensuring every output is intentional, high quality and unmistakably Faculty.

  • Direct creative development across campaigns, visual identity applications, video and design, holding a high bar for craft.

  • Partner with the Head of Storytelling - who owns thought leadership and the lab-driven POV - to ensure content and creative output reinforce the same brand narrative and a consistent standard of storytelling.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing and Communications Leadership to develop and deliver integrated strategies.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team spanning digital, events, creative and brand disciplines, raising individual capability while staying hands-on where your own judgement adds most value.

  • Bring bold ideas, energy and vision, challenging marketing orthodoxies to bring Faculty marketing to a new level

  • Lead the team to become truly AI-native - using AI tools to work faster and push craft further, as well as identifying opportunities to deploy AI-enabled marketing tools and skills across the business

  • Support the international expansion of the Faculty brand, working with regional colleagues to ensure it travels well and adapts where it needs to.

Who we're looking for

  • Significant experience in the technology / AI space

  • Proven ability to build and own a brand strategy for a technology brand, from foundational narratives through to visual identity and tone of voice

  • A proven ability to find the story in complex, technical material and tell it with clarity, confidence and a genuine point of view, with an instinct for which formats will make it land.

  • Experience co-creating and owning a marketing plan tightly aligned to business strategy, translating ambition into a deliverable, resourced plan.

  • A strong eye and a high bar. Experience directing creatives, designers and agencies to produce work that is sharp and distinctive.

  • A track record of holding a team to intentional, deliberate and precise execution: premium assets, purposeful campaigns, and writing that is parsimonious and human

  • Experience owning a company's digital platforms and driving brand equity, not just lead volume.

  • Comfortable partnering with editorial and content leads to ensure output reinforces brand positioning and a consistent point of view.

  • A sharp instinct for what makes a brand distinctive in a crowded category, and the conviction to say no to generic execution.

  • Skilled at working alongside C-suite leaders and technical experts, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and a bias for delivery.

  • An ability to operate at the upper echelons of a business, and to show how brand and marketing strategy is aligned to commercial goals and actively helping achieve them.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. A player-coach who neither hides behind the team nor bottlenecks it.

  • Deep understanding of AI, its transformative potential when deployed at enterprise and government scale, its associated risks, and the current landscape of global AI policy and safety discourse.

  • Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  • Introduction interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  • Panel Interview (60 mins)

  • Meet the team (60 mins)

  • Final Stage Interview with the CCO (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go is a platform for building and deploying custom AI agents, made for the document-heavy work finance and insurance teams handle every day. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in. It runs on the latest models too, including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Have a look at what we're building for finance and insurance.

Most AI agents still behave like black boxes. They wander off-task, miss the context that matters, and make calls you can't check. Go Agents are different: predictable, transparent, and auditable at every step.

  • Build custom AI workflows with controlled analysis at every stage. Every output comes with citations and a full audit trail, so the human in the loop can see exactly how it got there.

  • The Context Graph makes all your data (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place, giving your agents the context to be properly useful. It's your institutional memory.

The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have

  • A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products.

  • We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work.

  • We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon

  • Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control.

What you’ll be doing from day one:

  • Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises.

  • Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day.

  • Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost.

  • Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation.

Who you are

  • Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud.

  • Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn).

  • A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers.

  • Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £100K – £125K • Offers Equity

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We're hiring our first Demand Generation Lead for EMEA, Middle East and Emerging Markets. Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

  • Visa sponsorship: Yes

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Business Automation Engineer

As part of the Customer Care Service Design team, a Business Automation Engineer is responsible for identifying operational inefficiencies and transforming manual processes into scalable, automated solutions that improve how our teams work.

He/She leverages a combination of workflow automation, data platforms, cloud technologies, and emerging AI capabilities to build reliable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational consistency, and enable Customer Care teams to scale efficiently.

Working closely with stakeholders across Customer Care, Product, Engineering, and other business functions, the Business Automation Engineer translates operational challenges into practical automation opportunities and delivers solutions using our supported technology stack, including Make.com, Airtable, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Zendesk, and emerging AI-powered tools.

Their work alternates between supporting the day-to-day stability of our tooling ecosystem and delivering roadmap initiatives that improve operational efficiency, automation maturity, and user experience.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain automation solutions

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy automations that eliminate manual work and improve operational efficiency.

  • Maintain and enhance existing automations, integrations, and workflows to ensure reliability and scalability.

  • Troubleshoot issues and provide ongoing support for deployed solutions.

Translate operational needs into technical solutions

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand pain points, process gaps, and operational challenges.

  • Convert business requirements into clear automation designs and implementation plans.

  • Balance speed, simplicity, and long-term maintainability when designing solutions.

Leverage our automation and AI ecosystem

  • Build solutions using supported enterprise platforms including Make.com, Airtable, AWS, Zendesk, and approved AI technologies.

  • Explore opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities and intelligent automation where they can improve operational outcomes.

  • Support experimentation and validation of new technologies that could increase automation maturity across the organization.



Support strategic initiatives

  • Contribute technical expertise to roadmap projects and cross-functional initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Tooling, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver automation solutions aligned with business objectives.

  • Help ensure solutions are documented, maintainable, and scalable.

Success Looks Like

  • Manual effort is reduced through reliable automation.

  • Solutions are adopted and valued by internal users.

  • Automations require minimal ongoing maintenance after deployment.

  • Operational inefficiencies are proactively identified and addressed.

  • Roadmap initiatives are delivered successfully and sustainably.

  • AI and automation opportunities are evaluated pragmatically and implemented where they provide measurable value.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The ideal candidate holds a degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, or a related field, although equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Candidates should have at least two years of experience in technical support, ideally within Fintech, Banking, Financial Services, or another technically complex environment.

Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting gateways and card processing, troubleshooting APIs and integration errors, investigating logs and data, and diagnosing transaction issues. They should be able to interpret technical evidence, identify patterns, and apply a structured approach to problem solving. Strong communication skills are essential, as the role involves managing complex merchant enquiries and collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.

The merchant is always at the centre of our work. We are looking for people with experience in, and a genuine desire to work in, customer support, helping merchants remove blockers and improve their results. Successful candidates demonstrate ownership, a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to quality. Comprehensive payments training will be provided, so prior payments experience is not required where the candidate has a strong technical support and troubleshooting foundation.

The Team

Merchant Product Support is a specialised global technical support function that sits between frontline support and specialist Product or Engineering teams in the ticket flow. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area.

The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams.

We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions.

Role Overview

The Analyst I is the foundational specialist tier within Merchant Product Support. The role receives and manages merchant and internal requests across channels such as instant messaging, email, and web forms. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. When an issue requires deeper expertise, they engage the appropriate internal team or escalate to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst with clear evidence and relevant troubleshooting details.

Troubleshooting is at the core of the role. Analysts investigate payment flows, system logs, transaction data, and other technical evidence to diagnose issues, identify recurring patterns, and understand emerging trends. Areas of investigation may include advanced financial investigations, payment transaction anomalies, REST API and integration errors, webhook failures, Vault and tokenisation issues, authentication, fraud detection logic, gateway and card processing issues, platform errors, and changes in payment performance or authorisation rates. The team also supports issues affecting payment methods such as PayPal, KNET, Klarna, SEPA, MB WAY, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

This is a specialist role supported by targeted training designed to build deep expertise in payment flows and enable consistently high-quality problem solving. Analysts use advanced tools and techniques for technical investigation and API debugging while developing the knowledge required to resolve issues efficiently and help merchants maintain successful payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Ticket Management: Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system; remain logged in and active during working hours.

  • Customer Support: Acknowledge, investigate, and respond to merchant inquiries via the ticketing system, as well as internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.

  • Investigation & Escalation: Perform initial investigations; refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate.

  • Knowledge Management: Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation updated.

  • Product Expertise: Maintain a solid understanding of products, services, and policies to provide accurate information.

  • Quality Assurance: Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimize errors and provide consistent care.

  • Issue Identification: Categorize global queue issues and identify repetitive problems, escalating the likely root causes to the wider team.

  • Process Improvement: Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Product Onboarding: Actively participate in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our FinCrime AML/CTF Manager, you'll lead, grow, and manage our 1st line AML/CTF operations team, translating compliance policies into smooth, actionable risk management processes across the entire customer lifecycle.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Customer Risk Management - Owning and maintaining the Customer Risk Assessment Frameworks, ensuring risk scoring and categorisation accurately reflect financial crime realities.

  • Lifecycle & Periodic Reviews - Leading periodic and event-driven reviews across the customer portfolio to dynamically reassess customer risk categorisations.

  • Oversight of Due Diligence Activities - Overseeing onboarding and ongoing monitoring activities executed by KYC and KYB teams, aligning internal controls with regulatory expectations.

  • Product Requirements & UX Optimisation - Partnering closely with Product teams to define actionable onboarding requirements that balance regulatory compliance with a frictionless user experience.

  • Surveillance & Detection Management - Overseeing end-to-end transaction monitoring for all AML/CTF typologies, including timely assessments, escalations, and scenario calibrations.

  • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Mentoring and scaling a team of AML/CTF analysts, driving operational excellence, and regularly reporting risk metrics to senior management.

  • Compliance Translation - Acting as the primary liaison to the 2nd Line Compliance team, proactively translating regulatory updates into scalable operational workflows.

  • Reporting to the FIU - Serving as the final 1st line approver for Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs).

  • Audit & Regulatory Liaison - Preparing operational documentation and data for internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and inquiries from competent authorities.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone equipped with strong leadership, deep regulatory mastery, and an operational mindset to protect our ecosystem against financial crime.

  • Experience - 6+ years in AML/CTF operations within Fintech, digital banking, or payment processing environments, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing dedicated teams.

  • Regulatory Knowledge - Profound understanding of EU AML Directives and FATF recommendations, with strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulatory requirements (knowledge of Italian regulations is a plus).

  • Certifications - Professional certification such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent is highly expected.

  • Operational Framework Mastery - Proven track record managing transaction monitoring systems, reviewing/approving SARs/STRs, and designing practical customer risk-rating frameworks.

  • Stakeholder & Communication Skills - Exceptional ability to negotiate, collaborate across functions, and liaise seamlessly with 2nd line compliance teams.

  • Data-Driven Leadership - Strong analytical mindset capable of leveraging KPIs and data tools (such as HEX, SQL, or Splunk) to optimize operational queues and assess resource needs.

  • Change Management Mindset - Agility to lead teams through hyper-growth, shifting regulations, and tech upgrades while maintaining high morale and performance.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

* We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change your mind when a better argument appears.

  • Experience owning design from an unclear problem through to launch.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in a small product company.

  • Experience in a startup, as a founding designer or in an in-house product role, would be useful.

  • A practical approach to AI tools. The current workflow includes Figma handoff and clickable prototypes in Claude. Production code is not expected.

  • English at B1, fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Remote, open geography. Time zone overlap with ~CET is what matters.

  • Flexible schedule. Paid vacation, sick leave, and days off.

  • A flat team under 40 where you can bring a worked-out idea into any product — and get paid for it if it performs.

  • A design problem the market hasn't solved yet, in a product used across 140 countries.

  • Real autonomy from day one. You'll sit in product discussions, not receive tickets.

About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to take the Photoroom app to the next level for the millions of people who use it every day. You'll own features from architecture to polished interface, ship weekly, and help shape the product roadmap while collaborating closely with Engineering Management, Design, and Product.

Compensation: €90k-110k depending on experience + BSPCE

Location: Paris, France, with an in-office presence 3 days per week.

This is a Paris- or Île-de-France-based role, and we do not accept remote applications. We offer substantial relocation support (€10k signing bonus), including help finding an apartment in Paris and visa assistance.

About the Role

  • Build and ship new features for an app used and loved by millions, regularly featured by Apple, with a 4.8 App Store rating.

  • Own your work from A to Z, from architecture and coding to polishing top-notch interfaces that deliver a delightful user experience.

  • Ship a new version of the app every week, follow product usage closely, and make decisions based on fast user feedback.

  • Shape the product roadmap and new features together with Engineering Management, Design, and Product.

  • Raise the bar for the whole team through your code, your reviews, and by sharing your knowledge and experience, while learning or deepening your knowledge of technologies like Metal, Core Image, and CoreML.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience on iOS, mostly on consumer apps.

  • Strong experience with Swift and modern frameworks.

  • You care deeply about user experience and have shipped interfaces you are proud of.

  • Strong sense of ownership: you take initiative and are comfortable making product and technical decisions.

  • Pragmatic and iteration-driven: you favor speed of iteration over perfection and believe fast iteration is the best way to learn.

  • Fluent in English (French is not required).

  • [Nice-to-have] Curious about the latest trends in the iOS ecosystem and active in the community (Do iOS, Swift Connection, etc.).

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Benefits

  • Regular team gatherings, including in-person onboarding in Paris (1-2 weeks), yearly company offsite and team retreat, quarterly in-person meetings (monthly during probation period), and social events like winter party and hackathons.

  • 25 days annual leave + RTT on top of local public holidays

  • Competitive equity package with BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalized mental health support, including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Language lessons (English and French) for those who need them. Photoroom is an international team, and we work in English.

  • Relocation support (up to €10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance.

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France.

Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (45min)

  3. Take-home assignment (4 hours) and live review with the team (45min)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h in total)

  5. Reference check and offer

Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
